title: Protocol for Evaluating In Vivo the Activation of the P2RX7 Immunomodulator
author: Janho dit Hreich, Juhel, et al.
materials: 1 ml syringe omnifix-F (Braun, catalog number 9161406 V)
96-well clear V bottom plates (Greiner, catalog number 651101)
20X Buffer S, enzyme D and enzyme A from the mouse lung dissociation kit (Miltenyi Biotech, catalog number 130–095-927)
ACK lysis buffer (Gibco, catalog number A1049201)

steps.title: Prepare anesthetic and reagents
steps.instruction: Make all solutions in sterile conditions: (a) Mix ketamine 25 mg/kg and xylazine 2.5 mg/kg in 1 X Dulbecco’s PBS (250 µL per 25 g mouse) for i.p. injection; (b) Prepare lung dissociation buffer by diluting 20 X Buffer S in double‑distilled water, add 15 µL enzyme A and 100 µL enzyme D per 2.4 mL 1 X Buffer S in each GentleMACS™ C‑tube; (c) Prepare 100 mM ATP stock in sterile 1 X PBS, pH 6.8, aliquot and store at –80 °C; (d) Dilute TO‑PRO‑3 in 1 X PBS to 1 µM/kg, keep protected from light; (e) Dilute LIVE/DEAD™ fixable green dead cell stain 2 X in 1 X PBS (0.4 µL per 150 µL tube) and keep in the dark; (f) Prepare 500 mL FACS buffer (1 X PBS + 5 % FBS + 0.5 % EDTA), store at 4 °C and keep on ice; (g) Prepare antibody mix in FACS buffer: CD45 BUV395 1/100, P2RX7 PE 1/8 (or isotype control rat IgG2b κ PE 1/8).

steps.title: Anesthetize mouse and intranasal dosing
steps.instruction: Inject each mouse i.p. with 250 µL of the ketamine/xylazine mixture using a 1 mL syringe with a 26 G needle; place the mouse in a box with 5 % isoflurane for 1 minute; when fully anesthetized, hold the mouse upright and deliver 25 µL TO‑PRO‑3 (1 µM/kg) into one nostril and 25 µL ATP (100 mM) or 1 X PBS into the other nostril with a micropipette.

steps.title: Sacrifice mouse and harvest lungs
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mouse by cervical elongation, spray the thorax with 70 % ethanol, excise the lungs using fine sharp scissors and pliers, separate the lobes and place them into a GentleMACS™ C‑tube containing the lung dissociation buffer prepared above.

steps.title: Dissociate lung tissue to single cells
steps.instruction: Run the GentleMACS™ Octo dissociator with heaters using the 37_m_LDK1 program; after the program, resuspend the tissue, pass the suspension through a 100 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL polypropylene tube, wash the C‑tube with 1 X Buffer S and pass the wash through the same strainer.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells and wash
steps.instruction: Discard the strainer and centrifuge the tube at 1200 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes; aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold ACK lysis buffer for 30 seconds, add 30 mL 1 X PBS to stop the reaction, centrifuge again at 1200 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes, and aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: Count cells and perform Live/Dead staining
steps.instruction: Count the cells, aliquot 1 × 10⁶ cells into 150 µL 1 X PBS in a 5 mL polypropylene tube, add 150 µL Green Live/Dead stain (2 X) or 150 µL 1 X PBS for an unstained control, vortex and incubate in the dark at room temperature for 30 minutes; add 3 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge at 1200 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes, aspirate completely and resuspend the pellet in 100 µL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors and stain surface markers
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a 96‑well V‑bottom plate, centrifuge at 1300 rpm, 4 °C for 3 minutes and flick the plate; add anti‑CD16/32 (1/100) diluted in FACS buffer, incubate 10 minutes in the dark with agitation; centrifuge 1300 rpm, 4 °C for 3 minutes, flick; add the antibody mix (CD45 BUV395 1/100, P2RX7 PE 1/8 or isotype control 1/8) diluted in FACS buffer and mix immediately with a multichannel pipette; incubate 20 minutes at 4 °C in the dark with agitation; add 100 µL FACS buffer per well, centrifuge 1300 rpm, 4 °C for 3 minutes, flick and finally resuspend cells in 100 µL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Acquire and analyze flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run the stained cells on a CytoFLEX LX flow cytometer and analyze the acquired data using FlowJo software.
